summary: Review a homepage as a positioning and routing surface that must orient different visitors without diluting the primary promise.

must_inspect.why: A first-time visitor should be able to identify the category, intended user and problem before evaluating detail.
false_positive_guards: Do not require every ICP to be named in the hero when downstream routing is explicit and low-friction.

must_inspect.why: The primary promise needs enough mechanism to avoid sounding interchangeable with competitors.
false_positive_guards: Do not punish concise positioning merely because implementation detail is deferred to a clearly linked section.

must_inspect.why: Multiple audiences or jobs-to-be-done need a coherent path to the next relevant action.
false_positive_guards: Multiple CTAs are not automatically confusing when each corresponds to a distinct visitor intent.
Do not infer conversion failure without analytics; diagnose observable decision friction instead.
